notes: «حدثنا مسدد، ومسلم بن إبراهيم، قالا حدثنا حماد» : Musaddad and Muslim b. Ibrahim are co-transmitters of one level, the pair that narrates from Hammad
two taḥwīl branches; each writes its own names down to Abu Bakra, so the tail is null; the saying after the second branch is the same for both
«وقال في حديث حماد» is a wording variant of the first branch: left out
